Category.title: Category
Category.description: A curriculum category or custom shelf tab and dropdown section

parent.description: Parent category ID or empty string

visibleToStudents.description: Whether students are permitted to see this category

Link.title: Link
Link.description: A web app, GitHub page, or file item on the shelf

title.description: Display title of the link or file

cat.description: Category ID or empty for unsorted

kind.description: Resource kind: link, video, assessment, timeline, or file

assessmentType.description: Type of assessment: quiz, test, exam, assignment, past_paper, or project

dueDate.description: Assessment deadline or target completion date

maxMarks.description: Maximum marks or total points for the assessment

embedUrl.description: Direct embeddable player URL for video or interactive app

timelineDate.description: Target date or term week for timeline event

timelinePhase.description: Curriculum phase or topic milestone label

fileData.description: Inline text or data URI content

visibleToStudents.description: Whether students can see this resource

Config.title: Config
Config.description: Global configuration and teacher passcode state

seeded.description: Flag indicating default curriculum categories have been seeded

showExtraResourcesToStudents.description: Whether the Extra Resources button and section is visible to students

showAssessmentsToStudents.description: Whether the Assessments button and section is visible to students

showTimelineToStudents.description: Whether the Timeline App button and section is visible to students

timelineAppUrl.description: Teacher timeline app URL (external app or embed)

timelineAppTitle.description: Display title for the Timeline App

timelineEmbedMode.description: Whether to embed timeline in an iframe or open externally

/categories/{categoryId}.description: Collection of category tabs and nested dropdown nodes

/links/{linkId}.description: Collection of web apps, GitHub pages, and uploaded files

/config/{configId}.description: Application settings and access control config
